# ChoiceChips

<!-- Generated by scripts/sync-component-docs.mjs from ai/component-catalog.json and ai/component-composition.json. Do not edit; run `npm run catalog:sync`. -->

`@kerfjs/ui:choice-chips` · Kerf UI · component · Controls

A wrapping set of separated pill chips backed by native radios (one exclusive value) or, with multiple, native checkboxes (any number of values), with optional leading color swatches or icons.

## When to use

Choose one value, or with multiple any number of values, from a visible set too large for a segmented track, such as a color palette with labeled swatches or a set of annotation intents.

- Expose one exclusive choice among several visible options that must wrap onto more rows, such as a labeled color palette with swatches.
- Set multiple when the person may turn any number of visible, wrapping options on or off, such as label filters or annotation intents.
- Pick one icon from many (a command or category icon): presentation="icons" with an icon and label per choice and maxHeight to scroll a long grid, instead of an application grid of buttons.
- A section or filter strip that must stay one row (a feed's section filter on a phone): overflow="scroll" scrolls the chips sideways inside the group instead of wrapping the content below it down; wire wireChoiceChips to keep the checked chip in view and wireScrollDividers to fade the edges with chips past them.

**Not when:**

- Use SegmentedControl for a few compact choices on one track.
- Use Select when the choice list is long or space is tight; a multiple Select keeps a long multi-value list behind one trigger.
- Do not use it for removable tags (Chip).

**Alternatives:**

- [SegmentedControl](./segmented-control.md) (nearest)
- [Select](./select.md) (nearest)
- [Radio Group](./wa-radio-group.md) (prefer-over) — Use ChoiceChips instead of button-appearance radios that must wrap; a joined button group wraps into ragged rows with shared borders.

## Imports

- JavaScript: `@kerfjs/ui/choice-chips` — exports `ChoiceChips`.
- JavaScript: `@kerfjs/ui/css-values` — exports `fillColor`.
- JavaScript: `@kerfjs/ui/wire-choice-chips` — exports `wireChoiceChips`, `readChoiceChips`.
- CSS: the browser build of `@kerfjs/ui/choice-chips` pulls its CSS automatically; import `@kerfjs/ui/choice-chips.css` manually only without the `browser` export condition.
- Wiring: `wireChoiceChips` from `@kerfjs/ui/wire-choice-chips` (required).
- Declared side effects: browser-condition-css.

## Props

Exact prop names and types: [`@kerfjs/ui/choice-chips`](../public-api-signatures-v1.md#kerfjsuichoice-chips), [`@kerfjs/ui/css-values`](../public-api-signatures-v1.md#kerfjsuicss-values), [`@kerfjs/ui/wire-choice-chips`](../public-api-signatures-v1.md#kerfjsuiwire-choice-chips) in `public-api-signatures-v1.md`. Do not infer props from examples.

**Variants (configure, do not restyle):**

- color swatch, transparent (struck-through) swatch, icon, or text-only choices
- single (radios), multiple: 'toggle' (checkboxes), or multiple: true (a modifier-key multi-select listbox)
- default or compact size
- disabled group or disabled choices
- required (single selection only)
- presentation="icons": square 36px icon-only choices (an icon picker) named by hidden labels with hover titles, and maxHeight for a scrolling grid
- overflow="scroll": one row that scrolls sideways inside the group, with no scrollbar and faded edges where chips are scrolled past

**CSS-value props** (typed builders from `@kerfjs/ui/css-values`; raw CSS strings are rejected):

- `choices[].swatch`: color grammar; raw values: forbid; shorthands `transparent`; helpers `fillColor`, `uiColor`, `colorVar` — e.g. `swatch: fillColor("#3b82f6")`

## Composition

- Parents: any.
- Contexts: `wrapping-exclusive-choice`, `wrapping-multiple-choice`.
- Children: unrestricted.
- Built from: [LucideIcon](./lucide-icon.md).

## State and wiring

- value — controlled

**Wiring:** `wireChoiceChips` is required.

- Gives a multiple: true group its listbox selection: pointer and keyboard gestures, roving focus, aria-selected, hidden form inputs, and a change event on the group, and keeps the checked chip of an overflow="scroll" group in view (the optional wireScrollDividers fades its edges with chips past them). Radio and toggle groups that wrap use native inputs and need no wiring.

## Geometry

Margin: none · border: self · padding: self (layout role: controls). `self` means the component already owns it — do not add wrapper padding, margin, or borders around it.

## Accessibility

- Name the radio group (or, with multiple, the checkbox group) with label or with labelledBy pointing at a visible heading.
- Every choice keeps a visible text label; a swatch or icon is decorative.

The component renders controls inside it, so it cannot sit in the zones of a component whose root is a control or link. (`KUI-V014`)

## Styling boundary

The component owns its own styles. Configure it through its props and variants; do not override its internals.

Public class hooks (select for layout placement only, never to change the component's look): `kui-choice-chips`.

Never put `kui-choice-chips` on an element you write; render `ChoiceChips` instead (`KUI-L103`).

Everything else is internal: `kerf-ui-analyze` reports private or unknown `.kui-*` selectors (`KUI-L001`, `KUI-L010`), unknown or private tokens (`KUI-L002`, `KUI-L012`), and any application rule that restyles the component, forced dimensions included (`KUI-L019`).
